title: docs: the project site (docs/index.html) and the moe-daemon and moe-proxy npm READMEs name GitHub Copilot CLI
description:
Slice 6b of task-59e1d150 (GitHub Copilot CLI as a fifth agent provider). The planner of task-1c580985 split it from that row on 2026-11-06, so that row stays within the 5-file cap. Like task-1c580985, it dependsOn task-d609eae3 (JetBrains) and task-7739d4af (VS Code), because the site says the agent CLIs are supported out of the box.

OBJECTIVE. Five sentences on public listing surfaces still name only four CLIs, and task-1c580985 does not cover them:
- docs/index.html:21, the tagline: "An AI agent task board for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok Build".
- docs/index.html:49: "Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and Grok Build are supported out of the box."
- docs/index.html:129, in the install paragraph: "a coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or Grok Build)".
- packages/moe-daemon/README.md:3 and packages/moe-proxy/README.md:3: "an AI agent task board for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok Build".

DELIVERABLE (text only): each of those five sentences names GitHub Copilot CLI as the fifth CLI, in the sentence's own style: a serial comma only where the sentence already uses one. In docs/index.html:21 and :49, use the closing word the sentence already has. Nothing else in the three files changes.

NOT IN SCOPE:
- README.md, docs/PRD.md, the VS Code listing and the injectWorkerType comment in moe-proxy (task-1c580985).
- plugin.xml (task-d609eae3).
- scripts/CLAUDE.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md and the WorkerType NOTE in docs/SCHEMA.md (the closing row, task-59e1d150).
- Any behavior change.

VERIFICATION, from the repo root (npm run lint runs the role-doc linter in place; nothing is installed or built):
[ "$(grep -o 'GitHub Copilot CLI' docs/index.html | wc -l)" -ge 3 ] && grep -q 'GitHub Copilot CLI' packages/moe-daemon/README.md && grep -q 'GitHub Copilot CLI' packages/moe-proxy/README.md && ! grep -nE 'Antigravity,? (and|or) Grok Build' docs/index.html packages/moe-daemon/README.md packages/moe-proxy/README.md && npm run lint

Verify once, with a fresh run from the worktree root. Run executionContract.checkRefs[0] verbatim; it is the command in the task description. It checks:
- docs/index.html names GitHub Copilot CLI at least 3 times;
- each npm README names it;
- no four-CLI list ('Antigravity and/or Grok Build', with an optional comma) is left in the three files;
- then npm run lint (the role-doc linter; it runs in place and installs or builds nothing).
Architect dry run: exit 1 at base. In a scratch clone after exactly these five edits: exit 0, a 3-file diff of +5/-5, and the linter's OK lines. The command, its exit code and its output tail are the complete_task evidence.
Error handling for a red run:
- If the check prints a matching line, that sentence still has the old four-CLI ending; fix that sentence.
- If the count check fails, one of the three docs/index.html sentences was missed.
- If lint fails, it names a role doc over its cap. This task touches none, so report that instead of editing it.
Rerun the whole command after a fix. Never edit the command text.

Run one self-review of your own diff (git diff in the worktree) before complete_task: - Exactly 3 files change, with exactly five changed lines (+5/-5).
